structuredContent.answer: PopHIVE tracks 60 disease topics across 155 datasets. Topics: rsv, influenza, covid19, measles, diabetes, obesity, opioid_overdose, firearm_injury, mmr, dtap, polio, hepb, varicella, vaccine_exemptions, hepa, hib, rotavirus, combined7, pcv, opioid_use_disorder, heat_illness, injury_deaths, breast_cancer_screening, cervical_cancer_screening, colorectal_cancer_screening, prostate_cancer_screening, annual_wellness_visit, cardiovascular_screening, chlamydia_screening, depression_screening, diabetes_screening, pelvic_exam, flu_vaccine_adult, pneumococcal_vaccine_adult, maternal_mortality, maternal_health, infant_mortality, teen_births, low_birth_weight, salmonella, campylobacter, shigella, stec, enteric_disease, diarrhea, strep, pertussis, haemophilus_influenzae, copd, antimicrobial_resistance, healthcare_access, community_health, youth_wellbeing, west_nile, dengue, malaria, babesiosis, ehrlichiosis, vector_borne, census. The `stratifiers` column lists each topic's available breakdowns (age, race, insurance, ...). Note: the insurance and urbanicity coverage views are listed under mmr but their files carry all 14 NIS childhood vaccines as a `vaccine` column (Combined 7 Series, DTaP, Hep A/B, Hib, PCV, polio, rotavirus, varicella, ...). Use get_data(disease='rsv') to list one topic's datasets (each view key with what it shows), or get_data(disease='rsv', view='overall_trend') for the column schema and a data sample. Every tool's `provenance.data_url` cites the underlying file. An archive of upstream source files with longer history than the served datasets is indexed at get_data(disease='archive').
